name: js-csv
instruction: Implement parseCsv.js (CommonJS): module.exports = parseCsv. parseCsv(text) parses RFC4180 CSV and returns an array of rows, each row an array of field strings. Rules: fields may be double-quoted; inside a quoted field, '' (two double quotes) is a literal quote, and commas, LF and CRLF are literal content. Rows are separated by LF or CRLF. A trailing row separator does NOT produce an extra empty row, but a lone separator line DOES produce one row containing a single empty field. Empty input returns []. An unterminated quoted field throws an Error.
